changelog: Shake to cloak (Pro) now works right away on every mouse and touchpad.
Smart Notch hides during full-screen games, videos and presentations, and no longer pops open mid-game.
Opening Smart Notch always works: a second launch shows the notch and Settings, and a frozen copy is replaced automatically.
Fixed freezes from copying in busy apps, frozen windows, and offline network or USB drives.
Safe graphics mode on PCs whose graphics driver keeps crashing.
Troubleshooting buttons open the real log and crash-dump folders.
Fixed Drop Shelf drag-out and the tray icon.
